sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Earth Release, Wind Release.

system.description:
You create a two masses of dust particles of opposing magnetic fields, and then merge them together, repelling the particles across a 40-foot radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. For the duration, the jutsu's area is difficult terrain. Creatures attempting to see through the area have disadvantage on perception-based checks and any creature of your choice, that enters the jutsu's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d8 piercing damage and 4d8 earth damage on a failed save becoming Restrained for the duration and gaining 2 ranks of Sealed, or half as much damage on a successful one.

A creature Grappled or Restrained by a Jiton clan Hijutsu or clan feature you are used that failed this jutsu’s saving throw becomes Stunned until the end of their next turn.
